N-add11#1.zh: 站住！你们这几个朝廷钦犯，想走去哪里呀？
N-add11#1.t: Halt! Where do you think you're going, you fugitives of the court?

N-add11#2.zh: 那么快就追来了，这些狗官吏简直跟苍蝇一样讨厌啊！
N-add11#2.t: Caught up already? These dog officials are as annoying as flies!

N-add11#4.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N-add11#7.zh: %N死亡，群龙无首，四下逃散，最终仍为官兵捕获，押解回东京，无一得以善终........
N-add11#7.t: %N died. Leaderless, the group scattered, but the soldiers caught them anyway and took them back to Kaifeng. None came to a good end........

N-add11#8.zh: 经过一场恶战，大家终于逃脱了官兵的追捕。
N-add11#8.t: After a fierce battle, everyone finally escaped the soldiers' pursuit.
